# Google Skills

> Free and paid training platform offering certifications, skill badges, and learning paths for Google Cloud, AI/ML, and professional development.

Google Skills provides accessible learning resources for individuals seeking to develop expertise in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and career advancement. The platform combines hands-on training, industry-recognized certifications, and skill badges to help learners build practical capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Google Cloud
- AI/ML Learning
- Skill Badges
- Certifications
- Professional Development
- Career Development
- Hands-on Training
- Learning Paths
- Vertex AI
- Gemini
- Career Certificates
- Developer Community
- AutoML
- Authentication
- Credly

## Core Learning Platform

- [Google Skills Home](https://www.skills.google): Google Skills platform offering free training, certifications, and skill badges for cloud and AI learning.
- [Choose Your Learning Path](https://www.skills.google/paths): Learning paths and certifications for Google Cloud, AI/ML, and professional development.

## Subscriptions & Pricing

- [Purchase A Subscription](https://www.skills.google/subscriptions): Subscription plans and pricing for Google Skills training and certification programs.

## User Account & Profile

- [Sign in](https://www.skills.google/profile/stay_on_track): User authentication and login page for Google Skills account access.
- [Skill Badges](https://www.skills.google/profile/badges): User authentication and login page for Google Skills account access.
- [My Profile](https://www.skills.google/my_account/profile): User authentication and login page for Google Skills account access.

## Optional

- [Terms of Service](https://www.skills.google/terms_of_service): Legal terms of service and user agreement for Google Skills platform.
